controls.objective: Invalid required values quarantine the whole batch before publication
controls.procedure: Generate the documented four-fault batch; import and compare fact counts and quarantine evidence.

controls.objective: Identical imports remain idempotent across process-object restart
controls.procedure: Reopen and initialize the same database; replay the exact source and label; require original run identity.

controls.objective: A new batch identity cannot republish existing transaction IDs
controls.procedure: Import identical transactions under a different label and require full-file quarantine.

controls.objective: Published transaction counts and loss totals reconcile through the mart
controls.procedure: Require a nonempty fixture with positive confirmed loss; compare raw, curated and aggregated transaction counts and rounded confirmed-loss totals; check orphan facts.

controls.objective: Analytical customer dimension uses the documented email masking projection
controls.procedure: Compare masked projection with raw emails without exporting values; inspect analytical columns for direct fields.

controls.objective: Unsafe assistant instructions execute no SQL
controls.procedure: Supply an explicit injection-shaped request to the approved-intent boundary and trace executed statements.

controls.objective: Partial raw and derived writes roll back while failure evidence survives
controls.procedure: Inject a rebuild failure after deletion of derived data; reopen committed state and inspect data and safe audit event.

limitations: Local synthetic demonstration; no live AWS, Snowflake or bank integration was exercised.
Assistant input blocking is not role-based authorization for direct database/file access.
Email masking is pseudonymization, not anonymization; raw SQLite remains sensitive and local.
The report is not a regulatory certification or independent assurance opinion.
A report checksum detects accidental changes only when compared with a trusted copy; it is not a signature.
